## History

Joe Sloane was a student in Anne's classroom. He brought a package of firecrackers to school, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally exploded during a disastrous day.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P6](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P8](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0008), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P10](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0010), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), +21 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--joe-sloane.md)

Joe Sloane is one of the students taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. During a day when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was in a foul mood due to a toothache, she accidentally exploded a package of firecrackers that Joe had brought into the classroom. Despite this chaotic incident, he remains under her instruction alongside the other local children.

- Student of  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018)</sub>
